fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (2001 Gateway Blvd, 42.5328,-88.9565) landed in an empty farm field near the I-43/I-90 interchange. Correct facility is at 3000 Kennedy Dr, Beloit, confirmed via web search and OSM (Hormel Foods industrial building, 42.5210,-88.9776). Hormel logo visible on the west wall in Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding chain-link gate across the truck driveway at the SW corner of the yard (off the Kennedy Dr / Gateway business-park cul-de-sac). The whole truck yard is enclosed by chain-link fence with green privacy slats. Open driveway apron leads to the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed beside the truck gate in Street View (2022-11) or satellite imagery; entry appears uncontrolled-by-person / kiosk-style.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack -> remote check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Counted ~20 dock doors with trailers backed in along the west wall plus ~12-14 along the south wall; ~34 total is an honest estimate, hence 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two trailer drop areas: long row of parked trailers along the west drop yard (40+ trailers in rows) and an angled row of ~10-12 trailers at the SE; clearly 50+ across the site.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct building faces (west wall and south wall) - likely separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and large open yard at the SW entrance gives room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Beloit business park, bordered by farm fields and I-90; small-metro industrial setting -> Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant building plus a small detached storage shed/building north of the parking lot.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; I-90 borders the east side.
